buildings.description: Bakers use fresh dough made out of <style=Input>{Resource.Flour.WithIcon}</style> in an oven fueled by <style=Input>{Resource.Stick.WithIconPlural}</style> to make delicious <style=Output>{Resource.Bread.WithIcon}</style> .

construction.interpretation: sum of material inputs across distinct build-site formula definitions; stage repetition and alternate stages require gameplay verification

evidence.reference: Bakery field guide screenshot (gameplay-evidence/bakery-field-guide.png). Maintainer play report of 25 October 2026 agrees. The decoded formula graph gives exactly 8 Bread per Flour; formula 297381 is named "1 Stick -> 8 KitchenFire" although its serialized output is 10, so whether leftover fire carries between cycles is unverified.

Four public Bread piles (ResourcePileBehaviour 277583, 287164, 311412, 313966) each store Capacity 15 (research handoff, issue 10 comment 6405318044). The maintainer withdrew an earlier estimate of 40 on 26 October and asked that the decoded value be used. Whether all four piles are active and how the stop condition works is still to be traced.

evidence.reference: Field guide screenshot gameplay-evidence/fieldguide/Trading-Outpost-Evergreen.jpg (local agent playtest; research branch codex/playtest-observations, answers entry "Additional ... field guides"). The guide shows 12 Wheat and both 6 Glass Panes and 6 Animal Hides. The prefab marks the outputs exclusive (WorkplaceConfig.ExclusiveOutputs, set only on Trading Outposts), stores two separate 12 Wheat trades, and the Tournament hint FastMode.Hint.FirstTradingPost.3 says to choose the resource you want to receive, so a trade gives 6 of one or the other. Recorded on the base definition until 2026-10-26; it belongs to Trading Post Evergreen, whose stored trades match.
